name: SplitButton
label: Split button
description: Primary action with an attached menu of alternatives, composing Button and DropdownMenu in one pill, in primary or secondary emphasis and any tone.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler for the primary action

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries for the alternative actions

props.name: variant
props.description:
Emphasis, shared by both segments: `primary` (filled) or `secondary`
(outlined). The colour is `tone`'s job. `neutral` is the legacy value
from before the split and renders as `variant="primary" tone="neutral"`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour, shared by both segments: `default` carries the action colour,
`neutral` the greys, `destructive` the danger colour.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner on the primary segment and blocks interaction while an async action runs

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Icon for the primary segment — Material Symbol name or custom element

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the menu panel relative to the control

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the menu trigger segment

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the wrapper around both segments, not the primary button

Shortcut.description: A shortcut in the grammar above, such as `mod+k`, `shift+?` or `g i`.
